scope: Completed 50-firm news_network_50_2025 experiment; later repairs separately identified

variables.name: y
variables.timing: future five sessions; physically separate label files
variables.caveat: Exactly five finite returns; zero total squared return fails; no label floor; not intraday RV.

variables.name: b
variables.caveat: Zero mean, Gaussian, p=1,o=0,q=1; minimum 400 finite observations. Input multiplied by 100; output variance divided by 10000. Same-model standardized retry in data.numerical.

variables.name: rv1
variables.caveat: Alias of state.log_ret_rv1; finite full window required; no demeaning or annualization.

variables.name: rv5
variables.caveat: Alias of state.log_ret_rv5; finite full window required; no demeaning or annualization.

variables.name: rv22
variables.caveat: Alias of state.log_ret_rv22; finite full window required; no demeaning or annualization.

variables.name: earnings_confirmed
variables.raw_fields: Reuters diary status from explicit dated RIC rows and timing receipts
variables.timing: strictly pre-origin-close receipts; next-five reaction-session window
variables.caveat: Zero is not proof of no earnings; status construction in news_event_calendar_2025.feature_per_case.

variables.name: calendar_unknown
variables.caveat: Known-outside-window is a distinct possible status. In this saved sample the indicator complements earnings_confirmed and is redundant with an intercept.

variables.name: post_earnings
variables.raw_fields: latest usable eligible own-tagged Reuters headlines
variables.timing: story age strictly < 7 calendar days; strict pre-cutoff
variables.caveat: Mechanical headline proxy, not a verified release date or exact post-earnings state.

variables.name: pending_cash_deal
variables.raw_fields: latest at most 12 historical own-event headlines since July, sorted by available_at descending
variables.caveat: Always zero in the completed controls table. Does not verify cash consideration, pending status or closing. Preserve this limitation.

variables.name: log_news_count
variables.raw_fields: latest usable Reuters versions, ids, available_at, headline
variables.timing: age < 7 calendar days within eligible 31-day pool
variables.caveat: Own PERMNO tag; before headline-family shortlist dedup; not number of inspected articles.

variables.name: log_neighbor_count
variables.raw_fields: Reuters ids, available_at, headline; stored graph/co-mention relation candidates
variables.caveat: Target not tagged, relevant_common false, at least one neighbor tag, substantive_neighbor true; count before 20-story cap; includes stored higher-hop/co-mention leads.

variables.name: log_degree
variables.raw_fields: relation_candidates: unique PERMNOs from Graph.paths(ticker,2) plus frozen July co-mention
variables.formula: log1p(len(set(p for relation in relations for p in relation.permnos)))
variables.timing: June 6 graph held fixed plus July co-mention frozen before August
variables.caveat: Not direct supplier count; mapped security-neighbor count, possibly including focal PERMNO in co-mention/path construction; no extra exclusions beyond source code.

variables.name: anchor
variables.raw_fields: training y and eleven completed-run controls
variables.caveat: Pooled OLS, not ridge. Rank redundancy is preserved. Separate December revised anchor is not interchangeable.

variables.name: score
variables.raw_fields: cutoff-safe tool evidence and supplied anchor
variables.formula: LLM estimate of E[y | permitted evidence] - anchor
variables.caveat: One scalar per arm, not confidence or return sentiment. exp(score) is geometric variance ratio; exp(score/2) is RMS ratio.

variables.name: recent_ma_news_31d
variables.role: later repair only; not completed 50-firm control
variables.raw_fields: target-tagged retained history headline and available_at
variables.formula: int(any(target_tag and cutoff-31days <= available_at < cutoff and regex.search(headline) for retained history sources))
variables.caveat: Replaces pending_cash_deal only in later 30-firm design, which also removes calendar_unknown; still not verified fixed-cash terms.
